Sometimes the right buyer just needs the right strategy. 🏡✨

These sellers originally listed their home in 𝗕𝗲𝗹𝘁𝗼𝗻, 𝗧𝗫 with another agent… but unfortunately the home had 𝟬 𝘀𝗵𝗼𝘄𝗶𝗻𝗴𝘀 and no real interest. The market was slow and they were starting to feel discouraged.

They decided to take the home completely 𝗼𝗳𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗲𝘁 and give it another shot with me.

We 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗲𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗴𝘆, 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗲𝗱 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗹𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴, and stayed patient.

And guess what… 𝗶𝘁 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗲𝗱. 🙌

A buyer came along who truly appreciated the home and everything the sellers had put into it.

🎉 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗵 𝟲𝘁𝗵 — 𝗦𝗢𝗟𝗗 & 𝗖𝗟𝗢𝗦𝗘𝗗! 🎉

Moments like this remind me why 𝘁𝗿𝘂𝘀𝘁 matters so much in real estate. I’m incredibly grateful these sellers believed in me and allowed me to help them get to the finish line.

Congratulations to my amazing sellers on their 𝘀𝘂𝗰𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗳𝘂𝗹 𝗰𝗹𝗼𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗴! 🥂🏡

If your home has been sitting on the market with 𝗻𝗼 𝘀𝗵𝗼𝘄𝗶𝗻𝗴𝘀 or 𝗻𝗼 𝗼𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗿𝘀, it may not be the house… it may just be the 𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗴𝘆. Let’s talk.
